name: Wishbone - 18 Sweep

QB.rule: Take the snap and sweep right, flat and fast, behind the fullback. Turn up outside his block.

LH.rule: Run hard to the left like you have the ball. Sell it all the way — you are the reason the defense goes the wrong way.

coaching_points: The quarterback keeps it every time — tell him before the snap, there is no read.
The left halfback's fake is the play. If he jogs, nobody follows him and the defense is waiting at the edge.
The quarterback stays behind the fullback until the block is made, then turns it up.
